logp.method_description: The fat water partition coefficient of the complex Pta-d was determined according to the literature (Lv et al., 2015). Log Po/w was calculated as the logarithmic ratio of the concentration of the complex in the noctanol phase to the concentration of the complexin the aqueous phase. The fat water partition coefficient was calculated by using the following equation: Log Po/w = Log (Ao/Aw) Where Ao is the absorbance of n-octanol species and Aw is the absorbance in water. The resulting data were processed with Origin Pro version 8.0.
